summary: This guide covers the best priorities when forging Mythic gear through the Piece of Treasury feature. Players should prioritize crafting Armor and Gloves first because they can roll multiple primary attributes. For sets, Strike the Unprepared (+30% damage under Defense Penalty) is universally best for main DPS, followed by Dragonflame Scorch for single-target bosses or Arcane Eye's Requiem for AoE teams. Crit-based teams should aim for Crit Damage gloves and ATK% armor with Crit Rate substats, while Enlightenment teams should prioritize ATK% gloves with Enlightenment and Enlightenment armor with ATK%.
tips: Forge Armor and Gloves first when using Piece of Treasury because they have multiple primary attribute options.
Prioritize the Strike the Unprepared set piece (+30% damage against enemies with Defense Penalty) as the best option for every main DPS.
Forge Dragonflame Scorch for up to +24% bonus damage on single-target boss encounters.
Forge Arcane Eye's Requiem for up to +20% damage on AoE teams (Toxin, Burn, Corrosion).
For Crit damage teams (Ice Blast, Dauntless, Corrosion), craft Gloves with Crit Damage main stat and Armor with ATK% main stat, tuning substats to reach 100% Crit Rate.
For Enlightenment teams (Wild, Toxin, Shadow), craft Gloves with ATK% main stat and enhanced Enlightenment substats, and Armor with Enlightenment main stat and enhanced ATK% substats.
title: What to Forge First in Piece of Treasury? 🔨 Dragonheir Mythic Gear Guide | #shorts
